tasks.contract: Iterate list elements, gate JsonRef proxies, substitute the resolved subject, then descend. The bug descends without substituting so list-nested references stay proxies and dereference twice downstream.
tasks.body:
import json
import jsonref
from bravado_core.spec import replace_jsonref_proxies
d_list = {'foo': [{'$ref': '#/definitions/user'}], 'definitions': {'user': {'properties': {'first_name': {'type': 'string'}}}}}
o_list = jsonref.loads(json.dumps(d_list))
assert isinstance(o_list['foo'][0], jsonref.JsonRef)
replace_jsonref_proxies(o_list)
r1 = type(o_list['foo'][0]).__name__
d_dict = {'foo': {'$ref': '#/definitions/user'}, 'definitions': {'user': {'a': 1}}}
o_dict = jsonref.loads(json.dumps(d_dict))
replace_jsonref_proxies(o_dict)
r2 = type(o_dict['foo']).__name__
print('bravado_sequence', [r1, r2])
assert [r1, r2] == ['dict', 'dict'], [r1, r2]

from collections import deque
from cfnlint.context import create_context_for_template
from cfnlint.decode import convert_dict
from cfnlint.jsonschema import CfnTemplateValidator
from cfnlint.template import Template
def make_validator(tmpl):
    cfn = Template('', convert_dict(tmpl), ['us-east-1'])
    ctx = create_context_for_template(cfn)
    return CfnTemplateValidator(context=ctx, cfn=cfn, schema={})
from cfnlint.rules.resources.cloudfront.DistributionTargetOriginId import DistributionTargetOriginId
rule = DistributionTargetOriginId()
inst_group = {'DefaultCacheBehavior': {'TargetOriginId': 'grp-1'}, 'Origins': [{'Id': 'foo'}], 'OriginGroups': {'Items': [{'Id': 'grp-1'}]}}
inst_plain = {'DefaultCacheBehavior': {'TargetOriginId': 'origin-id'}, 'Origins': [{'Id': 'origin-id'}]}
e1 = list(rule.validate(make_validator({}), '', convert_dict(inst_group), {}))
e2 = list(rule.validate(make_validator({}), '', convert_dict(inst_plain), {}))
print('origin_sequence', [len(e1), len(e2)])
assert [len(e1), len(e2)] == [0, 0], [len(e1), len(e2)]

from collections import deque
from cfnlint.context import create_context_for_template
from cfnlint.decode import convert_dict
from cfnlint.jsonschema import CfnTemplateValidator
from cfnlint.template import Template
def make_validator(tmpl):
    cfn = Template('', convert_dict(tmpl), ['us-east-1'])
    ctx = create_context_for_template(cfn)
    return CfnTemplateValidator(context=ctx, cfn=cfn, schema={})
from cfnlint.rules.resources.ecs.ServiceFargate import ServiceFargate
rule = ServiceFargate()
def props(netmode):
    td = {'Type': 'AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition', 'Properties': {'RequiresCompatibilities': ['EC2']}}
    if netmode is not None:
        td['Properties']['NetworkMode'] = netmode
    v = make_validator({'Resources': {'TaskDefinition': td}})
    return [c for c, _ in rule._get_task_definition_properties(v, 'TaskDefinition')]
a = props('awsvpc')
b = props('bridge')
print('fargate_sequence', [len(a), len(b)])
assert [len(a), len(b)] == [0, 1], [len(a), len(b)]

tasks.contract: Extract the GetAtt reference, fetch the referenced resource type, gate custom-resource types, then emit. The bug falls through to the additional-properties error so valid custom-resource GetAtt values always fail.
tasks.body:
import tempfile, os
from cfnlint.decode import cfn_yaml
from cfnlint.rules import RulesCollection
from cfnlint.rules.resources.properties.Properties import Properties
from cfnlint.runner import Runner
TMPL_A = 'AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"\nResources:\n  Custom:\n    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource\n    Properties:\n      ServiceToken: arn.example\n  Helper:\n    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function\n    Properties:\n      Handler: helper.lambda_handler\n      Role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/role-name-with-path\n      Code: !GetAtt Custom.Code\n'
TMPL_B = 'AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"\nResources:\n  MyBucket:\n    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket\n  Helper:\n    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function\n    Properties:\n      Handler: helper.lambda_handler\n      Role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/role-name-with-path\n      Code: !GetAtt MyBucket.Arn\n'
def run_props(text):
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.yaml')
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, 'w') as f:
            f.write(text)
        template = cfn_yaml.load(path)
        col = RulesCollection()
        col.register(Properties())
        r = Runner(col, path, template, ['us-east-1'], [])
        r.transform()
        return [str(m) for m in r.run()]
    finally:
        os.unlink(path)
ma = run_props(TMPL_A)
mb = run_props(TMPL_B)
print('getatt_sequence', [len(ma), len(mb)])
print('getatt_b_detail', mb[:1])
assert len(ma) == 0, ma
assert len(mb) == 1 and 'custom resource' in mb[0], mb

tasks.contract: Locate the trailer, gate a zero Prev pointer, then gate strict mode to raise or warn-and-end. The bug scans for nearby tables instead so zero-Prev files always raise the wrong error or crash.
tasks.body:
import io
import PyPDF2
BASE = b'%%PDF-1.7\n' \
    b'1 0 obj << /Count 1 /Kids [4 0 R] /Type /Pages >> endobj\n' \
    b'2 0 obj << >> endobj\n' \
    b'3 0 obj << >> endobj\n' \
    b'4 0 obj << /Contents 3 0 R /CropBox [0.0 0.0 2550.0 3508.0]' \
    b' /MediaBox [0.0 0.0 2550.0 3508.0] /Parent 1 0 R' \
    b' /Resources << /Font << >> >>' \
    b' /Rotate 0 /Type /Page >> endobj\n' \
    b'5 0 obj << /Pages 1 0 R /Type /Catalog >> endobj\n' \
    b'xref 1 5\n' \
    b'%010d 00000 n\n' \
    b'%010d 00000 n\n' \
    b'%010d 00000 n\n' \
    b'%010d 00000 n\n' \
    b'%010d 00000 n\n' \
    b'trailer << %s/Root 5 0 R /Size 6 >>\n' \
    b'startxref %d\n' \
    b'%%%%EOF'
def build(with_prev):
    data = BASE % (BASE.find(b'1 0 obj'), BASE.find(b'2 0 obj'), BASE.find(b'3 0 obj'), BASE.find(b'4 0 obj'), BASE.find(b'5 0 obj'), b'/Prev 0 ' if with_prev else b'', BASE.find(b'xref'))
    return io.BytesIO(data)
r_nonstrict_prev = PyPDF2.PdfFileReader(build(True), strict=False)
r_plain = PyPDF2.PdfFileReader(build(False), strict=False)
print('pdf_sequence', [type(r_nonstrict_prev).__name__, type(r_plain).__name__])
assert type(r_nonstrict_prev).__name__ == 'PdfFileReader'
assert type(r_plain).__name__ == 'PdfFileReader'

from collections import deque
from cfnlint.context import create_context_for_template
from cfnlint.decode import convert_dict
from cfnlint.jsonschema import CfnTemplateValidator
from cfnlint.template import Template
def make_validator(tmpl):
    cfn = Template('', convert_dict(tmpl), ['us-east-1'])
    ctx = create_context_for_template(cfn)
    return CfnTemplateValidator(context=ctx, cfn=cfn, schema={})
from cfnlint.template.transforms._language_extensions import _ForEachValueFnFindInMap
tmpl = {'Transforms': ['AWS::LanguageExtensions'], 'Parameters': {'Environment': {'Type': 'String', 'Default': 'Production'}}, 'Mappings': {'Bucket': {'Production': {'Names': ['foo', 'bar']}}}}
cfn = Template('', convert_dict(tmpl), ['us-east-1'])
m1 = _ForEachValueFnFindInMap('a', ['Bucket', 'Production', 'DNE', {'DefaultValue': 'bar'}])
r1 = m1.value(cfn, None, False, True)
m2 = _ForEachValueFnFindInMap('a', ['Bucket', 'Production', 'DNE', {'DefaultValue': 'bar'}])
r2 = m2.value(cfn, None, False, False)
print('findinmap_sequence', [r1, r2])
assert [r1, r2] == ['bar', ['foo', 'bar']], [r1, r2]

from cfnlint.context import create_context_for_template
from cfnlint.decode import convert_dict
from cfnlint.jsonschema import CfnTemplateValidator

    return CfnTemplateValidator(context=ctx, cfn=cfn, schema={})
from cfnlint.rules.resources.iam.StatementResources import StatementResources
rule = StatementResources()
v = make_validator({'Parameters': {'MyParameter': {'Type': 'String'}}, 'Resources': {'LogGroup': {'Type': 'AWS::Logs::LogGroup'}}})
inst_match = {'Action': 'ec2:CreateTags', 'Resource': ['arn:aws:ec2:*::snapshot/*']}
inst_nomatch = {'Action': 'ec2:CreateTags', 'Resource': ['arn:aws:logs:us-east-1:123456789012:stack/dne/*']}
e1 = list(rule.validate(v, '', convert_dict(inst_match), {}))
e2 = list(rule.validate(v, '', convert_dict(inst_nomatch), {}))
print('stmt_sequence', [len(e1), len(e2)])

tasks.contract: Fetch the source base folder, join the patch filename onto it, then load the patchset. The bug loads the raw filename so layout-relative patch files are never found.
tasks.body:
import os
import patch_ng
from unittest import mock as umock
from conan.tools.files import patch
from conans.test.utils.mocks import ConanFileMock
class MockPatchset:
    def apply(self, root, strip, fuzz):
        return True
holder = {}
def fake_fromfile(filename):
    holder['filename'] = filename
    return MockPatchset()
def fake_fromstring(s):
    return MockPatchset()
with umock.patch.object(patch_ng, 'fromfile', side_effect=fake_fromfile):
    with umock.patch.object(patch_ng, 'fromstring', side_effect=fake_fromstring):
        c1 = ConanFileMock()
        c1.folders.set_base_source('/my_source')
        c1.display_name = 'mocked/ref'
        patch(c1, patch_file='patch-file')
        p1 = holder.get('filename', '').replace(chr(92), '/')
        c2 = ConanFileMock()
        c2.folders.set_base_source('/my_source')
        c2.display_name = 'mocked/ref'
        patch(c2, patch_file='/my_build/patch-file')
        p2 = holder.get('filename', '').replace(chr(92), '/')
print('conan_sequence', [p1, p2])
assert [p1, p2] == ['/my_source/patch-file', '/my_build/patch-file'], [p1, p2]
